title: Chapter 346 - 346 Published In Nature!

Chapter 346 - 346 Published In Nature!

Chapter 346 - 346 Published in Nature!

346 Published in Nature!

Lin Fan slept comfortably and soundly…

The medical and pharmaceutical industry, on the other hand, was in an uproar as if a level 12 storm had been set off.

This was because there was a new paper published in Nature—Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine.

Gray Rui Medical Group, America.

The president, Jonathan Darwin, stared at the screen with his sharp eyes.

The two technical directors were like puppets, holding their breaths and standing at the side.

After a long time, Jonathan Darwin slowly said, “What do you guys think?”

The technical director who wore gold-rimmed glasses said, “Last night, I conducted an experimental analysis based on the paper. The data is completely consistent.”

The taller fair-skinned technical director said, “This paper was jointly tested by Professor Mantis, Professor Harvin, Professor Roslev, and other professors from the University of California. They did a total of ten sets of data, and each set of data matched the paper.”

Jonathan Darwin said, “So you’re saying that this human islet recovery medicine can really treat diabetes?”

The two technical directors looked at each other and nodded. “From the current data, that’s indeed the case.”

Jonathan Darwin got up and paced back and forth in his office.

After a while, he picked up the phone on the table and said, “Arnie, contact Lin Fan, the author of Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine, as soon as possible. I want to obtain the patent for the human islet recovery medicine at all costs. At the very least, I want to obtain the rights to develop and sell the patent!”

Jonathan Darwin was the CEO of Gray Rui Group, one of the world’s top pharmaceutical companies. He knew very well what this medicine meant.

Some people said that AIDS was the most terrifying. There were tens of millions of people suffering from AIDS worldwide, and hundreds of thousands of people died from AIDS every year.

The number of people suffering from diabetes in the world had reached hundreds of millions. Almost every second, several people died of diabetes.

In the medical world, the danger and importance of diabetes could definitely be ranked in the top ten diseases!

Now, someone had actually developed a drug to treat diabetes. To pharmaceutical companies, this was like a nuclear weapon!

Therefore, not only Gray Rui Group but other powerful groups like Luo Shi Group were making similar moves.

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this.

When the dazzling sunlight shone through the cracks of the trees and onto the ground like a dazzling star, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes.

Out of habit, he glanced at his phone. A text message had already appeared on the screen.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000,000 yuan.]

Lin Fan ignored the message and yawned. He slowly got up, washed up, and ate breakfast.

When Lin Fan walked out and opened the door, a tall and sturdy car appeared at the door.

It was a Cullinan, which he had obtained yesterday.

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction. “This car looks good. I’ll drive it today.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan opened the car door and sat inside.

The soft leather seats, the carbon fiber panels, and the steering wheel that was full of texture, coupled with the dazzling starry ceiling, gave people a luxurious and comfortable experience.

Boom!

He stepped on the accelerator, and the V12 with 571 horsepower made the entire car roar like a dragon.

About 20 minutes later, Lin Fan arrived at Jiangbei University.

Lin Fan had just parked his car when Song Yi, Ma Zhong, and Zheng Jinbao happened to pass by with their school bags.

“A Cullinan! Brother Lin Fan, you changed cars again?” Song Yi’s eyes widened like light bulbs.

Zheng Jinbao said excitedly, “The appearance of it is too domineering!”

Ma Zhong did not say anything, but he stared at Cullinan without blinking.

Obviously, he was also very fascinated.

“Brother Lin Fan, can we go in and take a look?” Song Yi asked.

Lin Fan smiled. “Of course. Why are you being so polite with me?”

“Alright!” Song Yi said happily.

Zheng Jinbao and Ma Zhong… could not wait to get into the Cullinan either.

“The seats are too comfortable!”

“A starry sky!”

“Is this an umbrella that costs 100,000 yuan?”

…

The three of them touched each corner of the car, occasionally letting out a sigh of praise.

After a long time, they reluctantly left the Cullinan.

“Brother Lin Fan, where have you been these past few days?” Song Yi asked. “Were you busy getting this Cullinan?”

“That’s not true. Someone sent the Culinan directly to my house… In the past few days, I wrote a thesis and got a piece of land,” Lin Fan said.

In Lin Fan’s eyes, the mountains… also belonged to the earth.

Therefore, there was nothing wrong with saying that he got a piece of land.

However, when Song Yi and the others heard it, they were puzzled.

“Is it a very big piece of land?” Ma Zhong asked.

“It’s quite big,” Lin Fan said in a relaxed manner. “The mountains in the southern suburbs are mine now.”

Silence.

The entire scene was suddenly silent.

Ma Zhong, Song Yishang, and Zheng Jinbao were stunned.

Lin Fan had taken ownership of a giant piece of land!

“Brother Lin Fan, I’ll kneel before you,” Song Yi, Zheng Jinbao, and Ma Zhong said in unison.

…

Just as Lin Fan and the others walked into the classroom, an excited voice suddenly sounded from behind them.

“Lin Fan!”

Lin Fan turned around slowly. It was Professor Zheng Qian and Professor Wu Tian from the Biology Department.

“Lin Fan, your Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine has been published in Nature!” Professor Zheng Qian said excitedly.

As soon as he said this…

The noisy classroom immediately quieted down because there was no class.

They did not know what the Principles of Human Islet Recovery Medicine represented or what kind of paper it was.

However, everyone had heard of Nature!

If an ordinary student published a thesis on Nature, they would definitely be able to get a postgraduate degree, a Ph.D. degree, or stay in school!

If an ordinary teacher published a thesis on Nature, they would be promoted to a full professor!

If they remembered correctly, Lin Fan had just published a paper in Science not long ago, right?

Now, he had published a paper on Nature?

They were all humans, so why was there such a huge difference between them?

Wu Tian said, “Lin Fan, we didn’t do anything, but you wrote our names as the second authors. We… We don’t deserve it.”

At the mention of this matter, Wu Tian’s face was filled with shame and admiration.

Back then, when he encountered many unsolvable problems in his experiment on the hormone, he thought of Lin Fan immediately.

Lin Fan did not say much after he arrived at the laboratory.

At that time, Wu Tian was still a little confused. Perhaps Lin Fan really did not have much knowledge about glucose.

However, in just a few days, Lin Fan published a complete research paper on islets in Nature.

Looking at it now, Lin Fan did not say anything after he finished watching the experiment because his experiment was full of mistakes. He did not know where to start!
